Expected gain is honestly sub-epsilon, roughly +0.0004 to +0.001, so its main value now is determining whether the candidate signal survives seed variance rather than claiming a large level gain.

Its treats include excluded overfit, and its required accepted tuned-package parent is absent because node_001 was rejected.
The card is running-elsewhere and therefore unavailable; recency weighting was also already included in the rejected node_001 package.

expected_delta_basis: The seed-ensemble method card reports the approach as measured-alive on Pure and the journal specifically requests multi-seed confirmation, while also warning that the likely gain is sub-epsilon.

hypothesis: Because validation peaks around epochs 6-8 and then declines, indicating temporal-shift-driven overfit to stale impressions, seven-day exponential recency weighting combined with the required validation-selected consecutive-seed rank ensemble will improve validation primary by at least 0.002 over the single-seed unweighted FM parent.
